latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-browser: browser automation CLI for AI agents.

- Supports website navigation, form filling, button clicks, screenshots, data extraction, web app testing, and browser automation.
- Interactive snapshot system identifies clickable and fillable elements by reference.
- Enables command chaining for efficient, persistent browser sessions.
- Includes authentication and session management features, including secure credential vault and state persistence.
- Provides capabilities for data extraction, downloads, screenshots, PDF export, visual diffs, and connecting to external Chrome sessions.
- Supports parallel sessions and dark mode configuration.
